name: HoldForge
description: Silicate to native hold: recorded gates, corrected invisible dual portals and manual dual editing.

require-recording.name: Require recorded trajectory
require-recording.description: Record a complete matching Silicate replay before generating. Disabling this uses the approximate editor timeline.

strict-240.name: Strict 240 TPS
strict-240.description: Reject non-240 TPS macros. Turning this off converts time, but does not reproduce custom-TPS physics.

offset-ms.name: Timing offset (ms)
offset-ms.description: Approximate timeline mode only. Positive = later; recorded trajectories require zero offsets.

x-offset.name: Position offset
x-offset.description: Approximate timeline mode only. Moves all generated triggers; recorded trajectories require zero offsets.

max-triggers.name: Maximum generated objects
max-triggers.description: Combined limit for Options, portals, target markers and toggles. Invisible dual uses about 960 objects per second.

backup-level.name: Backup before import
backup-level.description: Save the raw editor level string before inserting a batch. Import stops if backup cannot be written.

manual-duals.name: Manual dual sections
manual-duals.description: Ordinary dual only: enable both controls at entry, skip macro Options inside, restore macro state at exit. Build your invisible blocks/pads manually. Requires a full recording; overrides Invisible dual auto and Shared P1 only. Verify is unavailable for this batch; use normal Play after editing.

dual-auto.name: Invisible dual auto (beta)
dual-auto.description: Ordinary dual: generate hidden native teleport portals along a NEW complete recorded path, for every form. Approximate movement; no P2 clicks. Refuses overlap with P1. Verify before publishing. No effect in Two Player Mode.

shared-p1-only.name: Diagnostic: shared P1 gates only
shared-p1-only.description: Native alternative for ordinary dual: leave property 199 unchanged. Not a confirmed dual fix. Regenerate and Verify to compare. Two Player Mode keeps independent gates.

unsafe-timeline.name: Experimental timeline
unsafe-timeline.description: Allow an attempt on levels with dash, teleport, timewarp or direction mechanics. This does not add support for them; recording rejects reversed X and incompatible clocks.

allow-existing-controls.name: Allow existing control triggers
allow-existing-controls.description: Existing Options Triggers may override the generated batch. Normally imports stop when control triggers already exist.

debug-enabled.name: Enable diagnostic journal
debug-enabled.description: Write bounded event logs plus last-stage.json for crash diagnosis. Previous startup checkpoint survives restart and is included in Export logs.

debug-inputs.name: Log decoded macro inputs
debug-inputs.description: Frame, input type, player, press/release and TPS. Re-import the macro after enabling.

debug-mapping.name: Log time-to-position mapping
debug-mapping.description: Record each generated frame/time/X/P1/P2 and the editor timeline roundtrip.

debug-runtime.name: Trace playtest inputs and triggers
debug-runtime.description: Record Options before/after, dual transitions, physical input, jump buffers, modes, level time, normal-play death attempts/results, resets and editor damage. Noclip or other hooks can suppress deaths before this hook sees them. Adds logging overhead.

debug-objects.name: Include generated object strings
debug-objects.description: Include serialization in mapping events. Requires Log time-to-position mapping.

debug-mods.name: Include mod versions
debug-mods.description: Record installed mod IDs, versions and loaded state for compatibility diagnosis. Captured when importing.

debug-max-events.name: Diagnostic event limit
debug-max-events.description: Report retains the newest N events. Crash journal writes the first N events of the session. Oldest ring entries are counted as dropped.
